cur-fossil-batagaika.dateNote: In 2018 a foal of an extinct wild horse, still with skin and hair, was found frozen in the Batagaika crater, a huge thaw slump in Yakutia, Siberia. It is about 42,000 years old (0.042 million years).
cur-fossil-batagaika.summary: A thawing Siberian crater that gave up an Ice Age foal with its hair still on.
